Headline: #3 King Drive Temporary Reroute near King Drive/76th
ShortDescription: #3 King Drive buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near King Drive/76th.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
#3 King Drive buses are temporarily rerouted in both directions due to, street blockage near King Drive/76th.

Southbound buses will operate via King Drive, 76th, Lafayette, 79th, and King Drive then over their normal route.

Northbound buses will operate via King Drive, 79th, State, 76th, and King Drive then over their normal route

Allow extra travel time.

Headline: #N5 South Shore Night Bus and SB #15 Jeffery Local buses Temporary Reroute near 71st /Jeffrey
ShortDescription: The #N5 South Shore Night Bus and SB #15 Jeffery Local buses are temporarily rerouted due to fire department activity near 71st /Jeffrey.

FullDescription.#cdata-section:
The #N5 South Shore Night Bus and Southbound #15 Jeffery Local buses are temporarily rerouted due to fire department activity near 71st /Jeffrey.

The #N5 South Shore Night Bus buses will be rerouted in both directions via Jeffrey, Stony Island, 73rd, 67th and over regular route.

The Southbound only #15 Jeffery Local buses will be reroute via Stony Island, 73rd, Jeffery, and over regular route.

Allow extra travel time.
